target.mode.label: Target mode
target.mode.autoHint: Every boot writes all installed user apps, same as before.
target.mode.manualHint: Only the checked apps are written and survive reboots; uninstalled packages are ignored.
target.emptyHint: No installed user apps found, or no compatible backend is present.
target.confirm.title: Apply target scope
target.confirm.body: Only the checked apps are kept. Entries outside the managed block stay untouched and missing backends are skipped.
keybox.intro: You choose the keybox source; there is no implicit fallback. Switching the source needs one Apply to reach the backends.
keybox.rkp.title: Device RKP issuance
keybox.rkp.desc: A device-unique chain issued by the local TA, never shared with others. Qualcomm devices only.
keybox.remote.title: Shared key pool
keybox.remote.desc: A community keybox from the self-hosted CDN. Broader coverage, but potentially shared by many.
keybox.note.overwrite: Applying overwrites the backend keybox.xml; the previous file is kept as .bak.
keybox.note.backends: Only existing backends are written; no directories are created.
keybox.confirm.title: Apply keybox
keybox.confirm.rkp: The device RKP artifacts will be written to every detected backend.
keybox.confirm.remote: A keybox will be downloaded from the CDN and written to every detected backend.
rkp.warning: Requires a Qualcomm arm64 device registered with Google RKP. A successful issuance only means you hold an RKP chain; it does not imply passing any external check.
rkp.confirm.title: Start RKP issuance
rkp.confirm.body: This contacts Google RKP and usually takes 10-30 seconds. No backend keybox is modified during issuance.
rkp.error.title: Issuance failed
rkp.delete.title: Delete RKP artifacts
rkp.delete.body: The whole RKP directory, including the private key, is removed and cannot be recovered. Installed backend keybox files are untouched.
rkp.blocker.library: /vendor/lib64/libkeymasterdeviceutils.so is missing; this firmware exposes no RKP entry point.
rkp.blocker.smcinvoke: /dev/smcinvoke is missing; the TEE channel is unavailable.
rkp.blocker.soc: The SoC is not identified as Qualcomm.
rkp.blocker.fingerprint: ro.build.fingerprint is empty, so the device cannot be identified to Google.
rkp.code.-18: Incompatible key format: the vendor TA rejects software keys on CSR_V2, common on hardware-key-only firmware.
rkp.code.-38: Invalid argument: the request does not match this TA's expectations.
rkp.code.-39: Unsupported tag: the TA does not know one of the requested fields.
rkp.code.-64: The TA is not configured yet; retry after a reboot.
rkp.code.-68: The requested hardware type is unavailable.
rkp.code.-74: Attestation keys are not provisioned on this device.
rkp.code.-100: The firmware does not implement this command.
rkp.code.-101: The command version does not match the TA.
rkp.code.-1000: The TA reported an internal error.
rkp.frame.unparsed: The TA reply matches no known frame layout. head_hex below is the first 64 bytes of the buffer and shows the vendor's actual wrapper.
rkp.frame.abi: The response buffer was never written: send_cmd accepted the call but produced no data, which usually means the ABI or argument contract differs on this firmware.
rkp.frame.payload_length: Length field disagreed with the actual data (legacy diagnostic).
rkp.frame.truncated_header: Response header shorter than 8 bytes (legacy diagnostic).
rkp.ta.status: The TA returned an error code directly; see the raw code above. The full table is AOSP ErrorCode.
update.none: No manifest for the current channel.
update.noChecksum: This manifest has no sha256, so the archive is only saved to Download instead of being installed automatically.
update.confirm.title: Install update
update.confirm.body: The archive is downloaded and verified, then handed to the current root manager. A reboot is required afterwards.
update.confirm.unverified: This archive has no checksum, so its integrity cannot be verified. Continue?
update.savedManual: Saved to Download; install it manually from the manager.
